sources.name: North Dakota 2026 Income Tax Withholding Rates and Instructions

notes: Read from the official publication listed in sources on 2026-10-20. Not yet signed off.

Section 2 percentage method for Forms W-4 for 2020 and after (also used when no form is on file, treated as single): annual wages, the annual table for the W-4 step 1(c) filing status (0% up to $57,625 single / $57,500 married / $78,475 head of household, then 1.95%, then 2.5%), divided by pay periods, rounded to the nearest dollar.

The booklet's worked example ($1,800 weekly, single, annual withholding $734.00) does not match its own 2026 table, which gives $701.51: the example appears to be left over from an earlier year, so it is not used as a test.
